name: Ratos AB (publ)
summary: Ratos AB (publ) is a private equity firm specializing in buyouts, turnarounds, add on acquisitions, small and middle market transactions. The firm does not invest in early stages and in companies that operate in the arms industry, pornography, or are detrimental to the environment. It seeks to invest in unlisted medium sized companies.
